entries.title: On iPad, the message box moves up when you write with Apple Pencil
entries.body: When you write with Apple Pencil, Infinitary on iPad moves the message box under the top bar with room for four lines, so your hand rests on the card below. A finger or keyboard puts it back at the foot. Turn it off under Settings, Appearance; the setting stays on that iPad.

picture.alt: Infinitary on an iPad on its side, with the message box at the top of Home above a card and Tasks beside them
